description_en: Submits a job in a cluster
description_zh: 调用SubmitJob在指定集群提交作业
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc submit-job --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --command-line ./LammpsTest/lammps.pbs --runas-user testuser --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitJob

parameters.help_en: The command that is used to run the job
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the user that runs the job.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the users of the cluster
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业命令
parameters.name: command_line

parameters.help_en: The password that corresponds to the username
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业的用户名。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户名
parameters.name: runas_user

parameters.help_en: The name of the job. The name must be 6 to 30 characters in length and start with a letter. It can contain letters, digits, and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 用户密码
parameters.name: runas_user_password

parameters.help_en: job1
parameters.help_zh: 作业名称。长度为6~30个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含数字、半角句号（.）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

默认值：0
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The path that is used to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业路径
parameters.name: package_path

parameters.help_en: The output file path of stdout
parameters.help_zh: 标准输出路径
parameters.name: stdout_redirect_path

parameters.help_en: The output file path of stderr
parameters.help_zh: 错误输出路径
parameters.name: stderr_redirect_path

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

true: The job can be rerun.
false: The job cannot be rerun
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。取值范围：
true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: re_runable

parameters.help_en:
The job array.

Format: X-Y:Z. The minimum index value X is the first index. The maximum index value Y is the last index. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
parameters.help_zh:
队列作业。 

格式X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业
parameters.name: array_request

parameters.help_en: The runtime variables passed to the job. They can be accessed by using environment variables in the executable file
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的环境变量，可以在作业执行文件中访问环境变量
parameters.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The URL of the job file that is uploaded to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
parameters.help_zh: 上传到OSS的作业文件的URL地址
parameters.name: input_file_url

parameters.help_en:
The command for file decompression. The command that is used to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. Valid values:

tar xzf: Decompresses GZIP files.
tar xf: Decompresses TAR files.
unzip: Decompresses ZIP files
parameters.help_zh:
解压命令。解压OSS下载的文件。取值范围：

tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

unzip：解开zip格式压缩包
parameters.name: unzip_cmd

parameters.help_en: The command to perform on the job after the job is submitted
parameters.help_zh: 提交作业后执行的命令
parameters.name: post_cmd_line

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue in which the job is run.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html operation to query the name of the queue
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业的队列名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/92176.html获取队列名称
parameters.name: job_queue

parameters.help_en:
The number of compute nodes required to run the job.

If the parameter is not specified, the Cpu, Task, Thread, Mem, and Gpu parameters become invalid
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业所需的计算节点数。

若该参数为空，则参数Cpu、Task、Thread、Mem、Gpu不生效
parameters.name: node

parameters.help_en: The number of CPU cores required by a single compute node
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点所需的CPU核数
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The number of processes created for a single compute node.

The parameter is applicable to Message Passing Interface (MPI) jobs
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点创建的进程数。

适用于MPI作业
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en:
The number of threads created for a single compute node.

The parameter is applicable to OpenMP jobs
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点创建的线程数。

适用于OpenMP作业
parameters.name: thread

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory usage required by a single compute node. Unit: GB, MB, or KB. The unit is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数，支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写
parameters.name: mem

parameters.help_en:
The maximum GPU usage required by a single compute node.

The parameter takes effect only when the cluster uses PBS and a compute node is a GPU-accelerated instance
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量。

仅支持使用PBS调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效。
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.help_en:
The maximum running time of the job. Valid formats:

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

We recommend that you use the hh:mm:ss format. If the maximum running time is 12 hours, set the value to 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh:
作业最大运行时间，支持三种格式：

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

推荐使用第一种格式。若最大运行时间为12小时，示例：12:00:00
parameters.name: clock_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of retries for the job. Valid values: 1 to 10. You can only retry jobs that are run on the PBS clusters.

If this parameter is left empty, the JobRetry.Priority and JobRetry.OnExitCode parameters do not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
任务重试次数，取值范围1~10。当前任务重试功能仅适用于PBS集群。

若该参数为空，则参数JobRetry.Priority、JobRetry.OnExitCode不生效
parameters.name: job_retry_count

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job retry. Valid values: 0 to 9. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

If this parameter is left empty, the priority of the job retry is min {Priority of the original job +1, 9}
parameters.help_zh:
重试作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

若该参数为空，则重试作业优先级=min{原作业优先级+1, 9}
parameters.name: job_retry_priority

parameters.help_en:
The retry condition of the job. If the exit code is the value of the parameter, the job retry is triggered.

If this parameter is left empty, the job retry is triggered when the exit code is not 0
parameters.help_zh:
作业重试条件。退出码为参数值时，触发作业重试。

若该参数为空，退出码非0时触发作业重试
parameters.name: job_retry_on_exit_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous link to submit the job.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
采用异步消息链路提交作业。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
